content: ProsusAI/finbert on HuggingFace remains the standard free FinBERT checkpoint (BERT fine-tuned on Financial PhraseBank, 3-class pos/neg/neutral), directly loadable via transformers pipeline. Alternatives (yiyanghkust/finbert-tone, ahmedrachid/FinancialBERT) exist but ProsusAI's is the most widely adopted/citied.
